body: As I stand there frozen, my gaze lingers on the faint shape of the footprints, the soles of the shoes imprinting the grass. The trail stretches out before me like a snake, disappearing into the distance. My breath quickens, my heart racing with a sense of unease. I take a cautious step back, my eyes scanning the surroundings for any sign of movement. I feel an overwhelming urge to get as far away from this eerie presence as possible.
